appName: Dart King – Ultimate VR Darts Experience
displayName: Dart King – Ultimate VR Darts Experience
display_name: Dart King – Ultimate VR Darts Experience
display_long_description:
Dart King is a simple and fun VR darts game made for everyone. Enjoy smooth and realistic throwing physics, multiple game modes, and a variety of halls to play in. Whether you’re practicing your aim or competing with friends, Dart King gives you an easy-to-learn and enjoyable darts experience in VR.

Play classic modes like ‘01, Count Up, and Cricket, customize your darts, and explore different themed halls. With aim assist options and clean gameplay, Dart King is perfect for both beginners and experienced dart players looking for a relaxed and entertaining VR game.

Features
• Realistic dart throwing physics
• Classic modes: ‘01, Count Up, Cricket
• Multiple themed halls to play in
• Different dart designs to choose from
• Aim assist options for beginners
• Simple and clean gameplay
• Perfect for casual and competitive players
